items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that was the first band that I played with when I came out of the navy.

ctx.x: Let’s talk about some other associations musically: Lionel Hampton. What was your experience with him?

Hamp was a masterful leader, and it was a great experience. I – that was the first band that I played with when I came out of the navy. But he was really a staunch believer in the fact that the people paid to come see him, regardless of who was in his band. He used to chew us out on a couple of occasions and say, “The people paid there money to come see me, not you. So just sit up there and do what you’re supposed to do.”
